prose: Basis: Techmeme's feed summary of a Reuters article; the source fetch failed. Reuters reports that a cybersecurity researcher watched over a couple of weeks as a Chinese-speaking hacker used AI agents to target more than 1,200 websites and breach over 100 entities - named victims include Deere and SharkNinja - while spending only about $5,000 in model tokens. The case is an early concrete measurement of how agentic AI collapses the cost and skill floor of mass intrusion campaigns.
highlights: Reuters: a hacker used AI agents to target 1,200+ websites and breach 100+ entities
Named victims include Deere and SharkNinja
Token spend for the campaign: roughly $5,000
A researcher observed the campaign unfold over a couple of weeks
Concrete data point on agentic AI collapsing the cost of mass intrusions
